description: Reviewed CI ratchet deltas for intentional functionality added before the architecture snapshots were refreshed. Every allowance is exact so unrelated growth or routes still fail. The route-manifest additions were folded into config/route-manifest.json on 2026-09-11, together with the three compact Sales Report routes added by #1379 and the Phase 4 proforma-capacity read added by #1382, so routeManifestAdditions is empty and any new route now fails until it is reviewed and folded the same way. config/source-text-assertion-baseline.json was regenerated once audit-source-text-assertions learned to see relative-URL source reads, so every test previously carried here as a reviewed delta now lives in that baseline, which is the canonical list. The source-text allowance covers assertions that landed on main after that baseline was taken, each on a test the baseline already records, led by the #1193 entry in server/routes/sp/spGoldenCoastPhase11MonthlyCloseRoutes.test.ts pinning the shared-charge Decimal expression. The three #1196 assertions in tests/supplier-partner-net-position-inclusion.test.ts that this file used to carry were removed by #1200, so the ceiling drops with them. godFileLineCaps is empty: every reviewed oversized file was split to or below the 900-line repository limit, so no line-cap allowances remain.

sourceTextAssertionDelta.rationale: Every entry above the retail-wave block asserts a contract that has no behavioural surface; the four recorded on 2026-09-14 are called out at the end and do not all meet that bar. The mobile-responsive files (phase1-critical-flows, wave2-factory-floor, wave3-erp-operations) assert on Tailwind breakpoint classes and data-testid template literals: jsdom applies no CSS, so which of the mobile and desktop views is visible at a breakpoint is only expressible as source text. realtime-wave2-live-page-policy asserts the ABSENCE of polling and of a second WebSocket in live pages — an absence no request can demonstrate. proforma-capacity-concurrency-wiring asserts that every proforma-linked creation path takes the capacity lock before it writes, and that the lock is taken first; ordering inside a transaction is not observable from outside it. company-deletion-contract asserts that storage.ts composes the dependency-aware deletion service rather than a second implementation, which is a wiring fact, not a result. factory-loading-soft-delete-overload-regression asserts that soft-deleted proformas and orders are excluded from the shared capacity snapshot and that both scan and bulk-import source their counts from it; the exclusion is a SQL predicate, so there is no request that can distinguish it from a count that happens to be equal. sales-report-compact-routes verifies that every sales-report URL the build-time Vite transform emits is registered by the mounted stats registry, and that the compact routes mount before the legacy raw route; the fetched URLs only exist after the transform runs, so no dev-mode request can demonstrate the wiring. tracking-continuous-list-cleanup asserts the ABSENCE of legacy pagination controls and page state after the continuous-list migration, keeps cursor-invariant failures as internal technical identifiers, and pins the quality-doc/type-escape-ceiling synchronisation; absences and cross-file sync have no request-observable surface. The three retail-wave suites and reusable-proforma-new-loading-lifecycle landed on main already over this ceiling and are recorded here so main can certify; they are the weakest entries in this list, not exemplars. retail-wave1-contract and retail-wave2-pos-transactions pin route registrations, migration DDL and unique index names; retail-wave3-reporting-audit pins reporting SQL fragments, a schema column definition and image lazy-loading attributes; reusable-proforma-new-loading-lifecycle pins resume-state handling and asserts the ABSENCE of the removed 'Proforma fully consumed' toast. The absence assertions and the migration/index-name pins have no request-observable surface, but several of the others do - the pagination caps, the /api/retail products-page URL and the route registrations are all reachable through a request - and those should be rewritten behaviourally, which will lower this number rather than raise it. Re-measured at 274 on 2026-09-14 after main's retail ERP integration (#1476) added seven more assertions to those same suites; a pristine origin/main worktree reports the identical 2335 total, so the merge itself contributes none. Raised to 276 while restoring main certification: tests/account-migration-control-reference-safety.test.ts (already a reviewed source-coupled test) gained two literal-text assertions pinning the durable-request-identity wiring (resolveFinancialOperationKey call and the account-migration.execute operation name) ahead of the voucher insert; that ordering has no request-observable surface, so it is asserted on source text like its neighbouring checks in the same file. maxAdditionalTextAssertions is measured exactly at 276 over the reviewed baseline of 2061, so any further growth still fails.
